xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4266: Command Deck model picker is clipped and shifts the conversation column left (dropdown inside overflow-hidden column; focus scrolls it)

plan.title: Command Deck model picker is clipped and shifts the conversation column left (dropdown inside overflow-hidden column; focus scrolls it)
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: In the Command Deck, the chat model picker (chat/ModelPicker.tsx, styled by command-deck.module.css .pickerDropdown) renders a 300-460px absolute dropdown inside the 320px conversation column (.sidebar, overflow: hidden), so the dropdown is clipped. Its search input uses React autoFocus, which calls focus() without preventScroll, so the browser scrolls the overflow-hidden column sideways and the column content stays shifted left until reload. The effort picker shares the dropdown class.
narratives.Proposal: Add a resetClippedAncestorScroll helper and a new useFloatingPickerPosition hook that places a position: fixed dropdown from the trigger's getBoundingClientRect(), flips/clamps it inside the viewport with an 8px gutter, repositions on resize/scroll/ResizeObserver, and resets clipped-ancestor scrollLeft on close. Render the chat model picker and effort picker dropdowns through createPortal(document.body) using that hook, fix outside-click detection for the portal, and focus the search input with preventScroll. Clean up the now-dead CSS, prove it with a stubbed Playwright spec plus light/dark screenshots, document the rule in STYLE-GUIDE.md, and add the new unit tests to the CI frontend subset.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Changing shared/ModelPicker/ModelPicker.tsx (ModelSelect, HarnessSelect, ModelHarnessPicker)
- Changing chat/usePickerPosition.ts or chat/MarkdownFileLink.tsx
- Adopting PopoverSurface/MenuSurface for the pickers or changing the picker frame's look (colors, borders, radius, shadow, width, two-panel layout)
- Adding keyboard navigation, focus return to the trigger, or new Escape handling
- Changing overflow on .sidebar, .layout, or <main>
- Closing the dropdown on scroll
- Running the Playwright spec against the operator's live dashboard on :3011

autoDecisions.summary: Fix chat/ModelPicker.tsx and chat/EffortPicker.tsx, not shared/ModelPicker/ModelPicker.tsx
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue's measured values (z-index 9999, 460px max width, focused search input) match command-deck.module.css .pickerDropdown used only by the chat pickers; CommandDeck/index.tsx renders the chat ModelPicker. The shared ModelSelect has no search input and a trigger-width dropdown, so neither failure mechanism applies.

autoDecisions.summary: Create a new useFloatingPickerPosition hook instead of changing usePickerPosition
autoDecisions.rationale: chat/MarkdownFileLink.tsx depends on usePickerPosition's { openUp, align, maxHeight } contract; a new hook avoids unrequested changes there.

autoDecisions.summary: Use createPortal directly instead of shared PopoverSurface/MenuSurface
autoDecisions.rationale: MENU_SURFACE_CLASS (max-h-[70vh] overflow-y-auto p-1) fights the two-panel flex-row overflow-hidden frame, PopoverSurface forces role=dialog, and its autoFocus focuses without preventScroll. ConversationActionMenu.tsx already uses createPortal directly.

autoDecisions.summary: Reposition on scroll and resize rather than closing
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue's Fix step 1 says reposition on scroll and resize.

autoDecisions.summary: Reset scrollLeft only on overflow-x: hidden ancestors, never scrollTop or auto/scroll containers
autoDecisions.rationale: Settings -> Roles hosts the picker inside a scrollable page; touching real scroll containers or scrollTop would make it jump on close.

autoDecisions.summary: Verify composer pickers with existing Vitest suites; verify Command Deck and home picker with a stubbed Playwright spec
autoDecisions.rationale: The composer needs a live conversation that the PAN-4198 stub harness does not provide; the stub keeps the spec off the operator's dashboard.

autoDecisions.summary: Commit screenshots to docs/images/pan-4266/ and embed them in the PR body by path
autoDecisions.rationale: Same approach as PAN-4198: GitHub has no API to attach images to a PR body and test-results/ is gitignored.

items.title: Add resetClippedAncestorScroll helper for clipped columns

narrative.Action: PRD WI-1 (.pan/drafts/PAN-4266.md). Create src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/chat/resetClippedScroll.ts exporting resetClippedAncestorScroll(start: HTMLElement | null): void, exactly as the PRD snippet: walk start.parentElement up to (not including) document.body; for each element whose scrollLeft !== 0 AND getComputedStyle(el).overflowX === 'hidden', set scrollLeft = 0. Never touch scrollTop; never touch auto/scroll/visible/clip containers. Add the header comment from the PRD. Tests in chat/__tests__/resetClippedScroll.test.ts run under happy-dom: set el.style.overflowX explicitly (do not rely on the overflow shorthand) and assign scrollLeft directly.

items.title: Given an ancestor with overflow-x hidden and scrollLeft 64, when resetClippedAncestorScroll runs on a descendant, then that ancestor's scrollLeft becomes 0
Given an ancestor with overflow-x auto and scrollLeft 64, when the helper runs, then it preserves scrollLeft 64
Given a hidden ancestor with scrollTop 50, when the helper runs, then it preserves scrollTop 50, and calling it with null returns without throwing
Add useFloatingPickerPosition hook for portaled fixed dropdowns

narrative.Action: PRD WI-2. Create chat/useFloatingPickerPosition.ts with signature useFloatingPickerPosition(open, anchorRef, dropdownRef, { preferredHeight = 400 }) => { style: CSSProperties }. Follow the PRD's 9-step algorithm exactly: GUTTER 8, GAP 4, MIN_DOWN_HEIGHT 240; measure only anchor getBoundingClientRect() and dropdownRef.current.offsetWidth (never the dropdown's own rect); openUp flip; left-align then right-align-to-trigger then clamp into [8, innerWidth-8-width]; style = { position:'fixed', left, right:'auto', maxHeight, top or 'auto', bottom or 'auto' }; setState only when a number changed; useLayoutEffect while open; listeners: window resize, window scroll {capture:true, passive:true} ignoring targets inside the dropdown, ResizeObserver on the dropdown when defined; cleanup on close/unmount; on open true->false call resetClippedAncestorScroll(anchorRef.current) from ./resetClippedScroll; before first measurement return { position:'fixed', visibility:'hidden', top:0, left:0 }. Do NOT edit chat/usePickerPosition.ts (MarkdownFileLink.tsx depends on it).

items.title: Given an anchor at left 600 in a 1512px viewport and a 460px-wide dropdown, when the hook measures, then it returns style.left 600 and style.top equal to anchor bottom plus 4

Given an anchor whose right edge is at 1500, when the dropdown would overflow the right gutter, then it aligns the dropdown right edge to the anchor (left 1040); given an anchor at left 2, then it clamps left to 8
Given an anchor at top 900 in a 982px viewport, when the hook measures, then it returns top 'auto' and bottom 86 (opens upward)
Given the dropdown is open, when the anchor rect changes and a window resize event fires, then it emits the updated style.left
Given an overflow-x hidden parent with scrollLeft 50, when open changes from true to false, then the parent's scrollLeft becomes 0
